title: anagallis arvensis f. decipiens
intro: Anagallis arvensis f. decipiens, commonly known as the False Pimpernel, is a flowering plant that belongs to the primrose family (Primulaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Anagallis arvensis f. decipiens include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating a range of health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
